name: HTML5 Canvas 2D Rendering Context

licensing.notes: Native web standard supported natively across all modern browser engines.

rendering_constraints.notes: Canvas drawing routines must bind to timeline progress callbacks and use seeded PRNG (mulberry32) rather than unseeded Math.random.

justification: Approved core technology. Used when procedural particle simulations, field lines, or function plots exceed SVG DOM performance ceilings (>1000 nodes).
